([[Baltimore|Baltimore, Maryland]]) | college = * [[Loyola Greyhounds men's basketball|Loyola (Maryland)]] (2019–2022) * [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers]] (2022–2023) * [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]] (2023–2024) | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2024]]) * First-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2024) * First-team All-[[Patriot League]] (2022) * First-team [[Academic All-American]] ([[2024 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2024]]) }} '''Cameron Spencer''' (born April 6, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Loyola Greyhounds men's basketball|Loyola Greyhounds]], the [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers Scarlet Knights]], and the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]]. ==Early life and high school career== Spencer grew up in [[Davidsonville, Maryland]] and attended the [[Boys' Latin School of Maryland]] in [[Baltimore|Baltimore, Maryland]].{{Cite news |last=Graham |first=Glenn |date=February 2, 2019 |title=We can get a little loud': Spencer family leaving lasting impression on Boys' Latin basketball |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/sports/high-school/bs-va-sp-boys-latin-basketball-spencers-20190123-story.html |access-date=November 11, 2022 |newspaper=[[The Baltimore Sun]]}} He was named the [[Maryland Interscholastic Athletic Association]] (MIAA) Player of the Year as a senior after he averaged 25 points, seven rebounds, and 4.5 assists per game. ==College career== Spencer began his college basketball career with the [[Loyola Greyhounds men's basketball|Loyola Greyhounds]]. He averaged ten points, 3.1 assists, and 3.4 rebounds in 23 games before suffering a hip injury and was named to the [[Patriot League]] All-Freshman team.{{cite news|url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/sports/college/basketball/bs-sp-cameron-spencer-loyola-maryland-20210309-7bqk2wmqinhyfcubirljeb53yy-story.html|title=Boiling' to return from hip surgery, Cameron Spencer is back at the perfect time for Loyola Maryland basketball|newspaper=[[The Baltimore Sun]]|date=March 9, 2021|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Spencer missed most of his sophomore season while recovering from his hip injury. He returned for the final five games of the season and averaged 10.2 points.{{cite news|url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/sports/college/basketball/bs-sp-cameron-spencer-loyola-maryland-mens-basketball-20211231-jihv2ksy4fftdodv2skaugvrxe-story.html|title=After missing much of last season to recover from hip surgery, Cam Spencer relishing healthy, full-time return to Loyola|newspaper=[[The Baltimore Sun]]|date=December 31, 2021|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Spencer was named first-team All-Patriot League as a junior after averaging 18.9 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.2 assists, and 2.3 steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.nj.com/rutgersbasketball/2022/11/meet-rutgers-cam-spencer-a-competitive-animal-who-may-be-just-scratching-surface-of-his-potential.html|title=Meet Rutgers’ Cam Spencer: a competitive ‘animal’ eager to make B1G jump with Scarlet Knights|first=Brian|last=Fonseca|website=[[NJ.com]]|date=November 7, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Following the end of the season, Spencer entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/loyola/Article/College-basketball-transfer-portal-Cam-Spencer-Minnesota-Loyola-Chicago-185875157/|title=Loyola Maryland transfer Cam Spencer talks visits|first=Dushawn|last=London|website=[[247Sports]]|date=April 7, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.nj.com/rutgersbasketball/2022/04/sharpshooting-transfer-cam-spencer-details-why-he-chose-rutgers-steve-pikiell.html|title=Sharpshooting transfer Cam Spencer details why he chose Rutgers, Steve Pikiell|first=Brian|last=Fonseca|website=[[NJ.com]]|date=April 19, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}} Spencer ultimately transferred to [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers]] after also receiving interest from [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]] and [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]].{{cite web|url=https://www.app.com/story/sports/college/rutgers/2022/04/19/rutgers-basketball-adds-transfer-cam-spencer-guard-loyola/7369445001/|title=Rutgers basketball adds transfer Cam Spencer, guard from Loyola|work=[[Asbury Park Press]]|date=April 19, 2022|access-date=November 11, 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.onthebanks.com/2022/4/19/23030201/first-team-all-patriot-league-guard-cam-spencer-commits-rutgers-basketball-big-ten-loyola-maryland|title=First Team All-Patriot League guard Cam Spencer commits to Rutgers|first=Aaron|last=Breitman|website=OnTheBanks.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=April 19, 2022|access-date=November 16, 2022}} He entered the 2022–23 as a starting guard for the Scarlet Knights.{{cite news|url=https://www.app.com/story/sports/college/rutgers/2022/11/08/rutgers-basketball-cam-spencer-wows-crowd-in-debut/69625384007/|title=Rutgers basketball: Cam Spencer wows crowd in debut|newspaper=[[Asbury Park Press]]|date=November 8, 2022|access-date=November 14, 2022}} Spencer scored 14 points on 6-of-8 shooting, including a go-ahead three-point shot with 13.3 seconds left, in Rutgers' 65–64 upset win over top-ranked [[2022–23 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]].{{cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/rutgers-stuns-top-ranked-purdue-again-behind-winning-3-pointer-from-cam-spencer-043016688.html|title=Rutgers stuns top-ranked Purdue, again, behind winning 3-pointer from Cam Spencer|first=Ryan|last=Young|website=[[Yahoo! Sports]]|date=January 2, 2023|access-date=January 5, 2023}} Spencer was named the [[Big Ten Conference]] Player of the Week after scored another go-ahead three pointer with 15 seconds left and scored 23 points overall in a 65–62 win against [[2022–23 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]] on January 11, 2023 and scored 21 points with six rebounds, six assists, and four steals as Rutgers beat [[2022–23 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]] 68–64.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/rutgers/Article/Cam-Spencer-earns-Big-Ten-co-player-of-the-week-203152482/|title=Cam Spencer earns Big Ten co-player of the week|first=Bobby|last=Deren|website=[[247Sports]]|date=January 17, 2023|access-date=January 19, 2023}} He finished the season averaging 13.2 points, 3.8 rebounds, 3.1 assists, and two steals per game.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/rutgers/Article/Cam-Spencer-delivers-for-Rutgers-despite-being-underutilized-206786449/|title=Cam Spencer delivers for Rutgers despite being underutilized|first=Bobby|last=Deen|website=[[247Sports]]|date=March 18, 2023|access-date=March 20, 2023}} After the season, Spencer decided to utilize the extra year of eligibility granted to college athletes who played in the 2020 season due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and entered the NCAA transfer portal for a second time.{{cite news|url=https://www.app.com/story/sports/college/rutgers/2023/05/19/rutgers-basketball-guard-cam-spencer-enters-transfer-portal/70232598007/|title=Rutgers basketball: Cam Spencer enters transfer portal, a late hit to 2023-24 roster|newspaper=[[Asbury Park Press]]|date=May 19, 2023|access-date=May 26, 2023}} Spencer transferred to UConn.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/37809324/uconn-lands-sharp-shooting-transfer-guard-cam-spencer|title=Sources: UConn lands sharpshooting transfer guard Cam Spencer|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=June 7, 2023|access-date=June 7, 2023}} He was named first-team All-[[Big East Conference]] after starting all 40 of the Huskies' games and averaging 14.3 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 1.5 steals per game as UConn won the national championship{{cite web|url=https://www.nj.com/rutgersbasketball/2024/04/how-cam-spencer-paul-mulcahy-rutgers-basketball-transfers-performed-in-2023-24-season.html|title=Cam Spencer won a title with UConn, but what about Paul Mulcahy, other Rutgers transfers?|first=Brian|last=Fonseca|website=[[NJ.com]]|date=April 9, 2024|access-date=May 31, 2024}} Spencer scored 11 points with eight rebounds, two assists, and two steals in UConn's 75–60 win over [[2023–24 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]] in the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|National Championship game]].{{cite web|url=https://www.ctinsider.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/cam-spencer-final-four-ncaa-championship-huskies-19393679.php|title=UConn guard Cam Spencer fulfills dream with NCAA title in one
